Azamgarh Triple Murder Accused Killed in Police Encounter

Arvind Singh, accused in the triple murder of three people in Azamgarh's Aharaula police station area, was killed in an encounter with the Special Operations Group (SOG) and Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS) on Tuesday evening. The encounter took place in Shambhuprur village. Reports indicate Singh was firing at the police. The incident occurred after a dispute during a puja on Tuesday evening that led to the deaths.
